g.text: Power: the C3's USB 5 V; every module on the C3's 3V3 pin.

g.desc: Power: the C3's USB 5 V; every module on the C3's 3V3 pin.

g.text: I2C: Elechouse NFC Module V3 PN532 (0x24, switch 1 ON, switch 2 OFF) and OLED (0x3C) share SDA/SCL.

g.desc: I2C: Elechouse NFC Module V3 PN532 (0x24, switch 1 ON, switch 2 OFF) and OLED (0x3C) share SDA/SCL.

g.text: PN532 IRQ and RSTO stay unconnected (firmware polls over I2C).

g.desc: PN532 IRQ and RSTO stay unconnected (firmware polls over I2C).

g.text: Encoder: A/B to GPIO 3/4 with internal pull-ups, common C to GND;

g.desc: Encoder: A/B to GPIO 3/4 with internal pull-ups, common C to GND;

g.text: push switch S1-S2 between GPIO 1 and 3V3, internal pull-down.

g.desc: push switch S1-S2 between GPIO 1 and 3V3, internal pull-down.

g.text: Buzzer module is active-low: firmware idles GPIO 0 high.

g.desc: Buzzer module is active-low: firmware idles GPIO 0 high.

g.text: Board: U1 plugs into two 1x8 female headers. Off-board modules plug into JST-XH headers:

g.desc: Board: U1 plugs into two 1x8 female headers. Off-board modules plug into JST-XH headers:

g.text: J1 PN532 and J2 OLED (GND 3V3 SDA SCL), J3 encoder (A B C SW 3V3), J4 buzzer (GND 3V3 S).

g.desc: J1 PN532 and J2 OLED (GND 3V3 SDA SCL), J3 encoder (A B C SW 3V3), J4 buzzer (GND 3V3 S).

g.text: U2, U3, SW1 and BZ1 are off the board (not placed on the PCB).
